summary.text: Mary Franson is a Republican state representative from Minnesota who represents House District 12B and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She first served in the House from 2011 to 2013 for District 11B and has held her current seat since 2013, and she co-chairs the House Capital Investment Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mary Franson earned a B.A. in psychology from the University of Minnesota at Duluth in 2000.
Her career experience includes owning Merry Little Lambs and working as a credit representative with AT&T, a licensed childcare provider, and a reality facilitator with Hay Dobbs.

Franson represented District 11B in the Minnesota House of Representatives from 2011 to 2013 and has served since 2013 in the seat she now holds; she has represented District 12B since January 3, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Health Finance and Policy and Human Services Finance and Policy committees and served as co-chair of the House Capital Investment Committee.
The Republican primary for her seat on August 11, 2026, was canceled.
